description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountSheetPopulator' is responsible for populating an Excel sheet with savings account data, including setting up sheet layout and filling in account details.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a sheet with savings account information, setting layout and inserting data rows.

methods.name: SavingsAccountSheetPopulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of savings account data.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and populates the savings accounts sheet within a given workbook, applying a specified date format.

methods.name: populateSavingsSheet
methods.description: Fills the savings sheet with data from each savings account.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths for the savings sheet.
